flags.message: metrics/statpack.md's 'Segment base rate by salience band' table is headed sal-v8 while record/context.json carries salience_version sal-v9. I anchored on the frozen cert_anchor.rate (0.731) rather than the table.

This is a hold petition: the government asks only that it be held for Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha, No. 26-104 (cert granted 2026-10-01, same question presented). The docket carries no Vide link, so record/related/ is absent and the band anchor does not reflect that the outcome tracks the lead case's merits decision.
